summary: iter-412 v11 Multiunit Abutment (MUA) validation. Backend: 4/4 pytest PASS (/app/backend/tests/test_v11_mua_iteration412.py, junit iter412_v11_mua.xml) — Phase2Submit model exposes mua_placed+mua_details; direct DB write persists dict-keyed details; PDF /case-report on 'Test Patient Zygoma' (6a8337dd64ad3269dc584a69) contains 'Multiunit Abutments (MUA) Placed: Yes', 'Multiunit Abutment (MUA) Details', 'Zygoma R1: cuff 3 mm | angulation 30°', 'Pterygoid L1: cuff 2 mm | angulation 17°', 'FDI 15: cuff 1 mm | angulation 0°'; regression PDF (non-MUA procedure) does NOT contain 'Multiunit Abutment (MUA) Details'. Frontend (Playwright mobile 390x844, Abhijit.patil, /procedures/submit-phase2/6a8337dd64ad3269dc584a69 after promoting status to phase1_approved): the MUA section heading 'Multiunit Abutments (MUA) Placed' with Yes/No buttons DOES render as expected on Step 2 (Surgery). However: (a) Torque Achieved section renders only 1 empty row without the '— Zygoma R1' implantDisplayLabel suffix — implantPositions state loads empty (torque-* testID count = 0); (b) Tapping mua-placed-yes does NOT reveal mua-details-section (details block never renders → all per-position labels + inputs unverifiable); (c) Console shows 2× 'Failed to load resource: 403' errors → the client's api/procedures/{id}/implant-plan GET fails auth on the preview session, so implantPositions and torqueValues never populate. Duplicate testIDs 'mua-placed-yes' / 'mua-placed-no' also exist in the LEGACY iter-139 section at ~L1367 (only active on All-on-X+Immediate-Loading+ImmediateLoadingDone gate) — non-blocking for zygoma flow but a code smell.

ui_bugs.issue: Tap on [data-testid=mua-placed-yes] does not render [data-testid=mua-details-section]. Details block gate `muaPlaced === true` never flips (state didn't update). Reference: /app/frontend/app/procedures/submit-phase2/[id].tsx:1054-1069.

Only 1 empty row without the 'Implant N — Zygoma R1' suffix rendered — implantPositions state stays empty because /procedures/{id}/implant-plan returned 403 to the browser (session/token issue in preview). Reference: /app/frontend/app/procedures/submit-phase2/[id].tsx:1030-1043, loader L159-170.

Legacy iter-139 MUA UI at ~L1367 also uses testIDs 'mua-placed-yes/no' and 'mua-cuff-{idx}'. Both v11 and legacy sections co-exist. Only v11 renders on zygoma cases (legacy gated on All-on-X + Immediate Loading), but on All-on-X cases both would render → colliding testIDs. Suggest renaming legacy to 'mua-legacy-placed-yes' etc. Reference: /app/frontend/app/procedures/submit-phase2/[id].tsx:1367-1416.

integration_issues.issue: GET /api/procedures/{id}/implant-plan returned 403 in the browser client despite valid login. Because loadImplantPlan swallows the error silently, implantPositions/torqueValues/muaPositions never populate. IOPA labels + Torque labels + MUA per-implant labels all fail as a downstream effect. Needs root-cause on the 403 (likely auth-header not attached on parallel request or CORS pre-flight).

rca_of_issue: Two-layer cascade: (1) The Phase 2 form's /procedures/{id}/implant-plan GET returned 403 in the browser session (auth header not attached correctly on that specific request, or interceptor race). Because loadImplantPlan catches errors silently, implantPositions state stays [] and count defaults to 1. Consequence: Torque Achieved shows only 1 row without 'Zygoma R1' suffix; MUA details block, when Yes were tapped, would iterate over the ['—'] fallback (not the real 5 positions), and Post Surgical Radiograph IOPA labels can't be verified. (2) Independently, tapping [data-testid=mua-placed-yes] failed to make [data-testid=mua-details-section] appear — muaPlaced state did not flip. Possible causes: React Native TouchableOpacity onPress not surfacing via Playwright force-click on this build, or an invisible overlay from the step-tab sticky header. Reproduction: login as Abhijit.patil → open /procedures/submit-phase2/6a8337dd64ad3269dc584a69 → open network tab, observe 403 on /implant-plan → tap 'Yes' under Multiunit Abutments (MUA) Placed → details block never appears.
